dispositions.summary: Interactive REPL --tag parsing only captures a single whitespace-delimited token, silently truncating multi-word tags and leaking the remainder into the title
dispositions.evidence: src/interactive.ts: parseAddArgs and parseFilterArgs now scan from '--tag ' to the next '--' flag (or end of string) instead of a single \S+ token, so multi-word tag values are captured whole; tests/e2e/cli.e2e.test.ts adds coverage for 'add --tag home improvement' and 'filter --tag home improvement' preserving the full value.

dispositions.summary: workflow/PROJECT.md links the new 'Malformed tags (import)' entry to docs/adr/0001-tags-import-abort.md, which does not exist; the ADR added by this PR is docs/adr/0034-tags-import-abort.md
dispositions.evidence: Post-review diff only touches src/interactive.ts and tests/e2e/cli.e2e.test.ts; workflow/PROJECT.md is unchanged.

dispositions.summary: Imported tags are stored as-is (no trim/lowercase) unlike tags added via --tag, so an imported tag with stray whitespace will never match filter --tag
dispositions.evidence: Post-review diff does not touch src/commands.ts; import normalization behavior is unchanged.
